text.en:
Raju spun a paper windmill and it looked the same several times in one turn.
"It has rotational symmetry," he said.

A figure has rotational symmetry if it looks the same after being turned by less than a full turn about a point called the centre of rotation.
The order of rotation is how many times it matches in one full turn. A square has order 4, a rectangle 2 and a regular hexagon 6.
Wheels, flowers, ceiling fans and recycling signs show rotational symmetry.

problem.en: What is the order of rotation of a rectangle?

text.en: It matches after a half turn.
It matches twice in one full turn.

prompt.en: A friend says a scalene triangle has rotational symmetry of order 3. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: It looks the same only after a full turn.

points.en: Rotational symmetry means matching on turning.
Order counts matches in a full turn.
